title: Archive search
description: A compact archive tab expands into a searchable document picker and retains your selection.
useCase: Fit local document search and selection into a compact toolbar.
interaction: Open search, filter documents and select a result.
reducedMotion: Keyboard, reduced-motion and paused-host transitions are immediate.
limitations: Local sample data only; no remote search or document navigation. Selecting changes the compact title; it does not open a full document.
look: Warm stone-grey page with a compact off-white paper strip led by a vermilion index tab holding a search icon, set in plain sans-serif.
motion: Clicking the tab unclips the paper to a full panel as the drawer slides into place (320 ms ease-out); the field fades in and the results slide down.
adapt: Open and closed states are CSS keyed on `data-open`: `.sf-index-paper` animates `clip-path` from `inset(0 130px 218px 0)` and `.sf-index-drawer` its `transform`, both 320ms ease-out. Replace `documents`; keep the combobox roles, `aria-activedescendant` and `data-instant`.
